displayName: ATSIQ — server-function p95 latency above 2.5 s

documentation.content: p95 of server-function requests has been above the 2.5 s SLO threshold for 15 minutes. Check Cloud SQL CPU/connections on the ATSIQ dashboard and slow `http.request` lines (duration_ms > 2500). Targets: src/server/slo.ts.
